text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1589
EXCLUDING CERTAIN AREAS FROM THE OPERATION OF PROCLAMATION NO. 87 DATED
AUGUST 9, 1966, UNDER REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3092, AND OPENING THE SAME FOR MINING
WHEREAS, our economic development program requires the progressive and orderly exploitation of our
mineral resources;
WHEREAS, pursuant to Section 3(0) of Commonwealth Act No. 136, the President of the Philippines issued
Executive Order No. 245 dated July 10, 1970 prescribing the procedures of mineral prospecting and
exploitation in government reservations other than mineral reservations;
WHEREAS, in accordance with Executive Order No. 245 and Presidential Decree No. 463, Baler
Consolidated Mines, Inc. applied for and was duly granted, first a Prospecting Permit by the Bureau of Forest
Development and subsequently, an Exploration Permit by the Bureau of Mines, over a certain parcel of
Dibudalan Mountain Forest Reserve located at Barrio Dibut, Municipality of Baler, Sub-province of Aurora,
Province of Quezon;
WHEREAS, various investigations, exploration works and feasibility studies caused to be undertaken by
applicant Baler Consolidated Mines, Inc. and verified by the Bureau of Mines revealed that the applied area is
more valuable for mining purposes than the purpose for which it has been reserved, and that the chromite
deposit therein could be commercially exploited; and
WHEREAS, applicant Baler Consolidated Mines, Inc. after having complied with the requirements under
Executive Order No. 245, Series of 1970, and under the Mineral Resources, Development Decree of 1974,
otherwise known as P.D. 463, now requests the exclusion of the applied area from the forest reservation;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the power
vested in me by the Constitution, hereby decree and order that a parcel of land within the Dibudalan Mountain
Forest Reserve established under Proclamation No. 87 dated August 9, 1966 (R.A. No. 3092), be excluded
from the operation of said Proclamation and hereby award the development and exploitation and utilization of
the chromite deposits and other minerals found therein to Baler Consolidated Mines, Inc., subject to existing
rights, if any there be, and to existing policies, laws, rules and regulations pertinent thereto, which parcel of
land is particularly described as follows:
Beginning at point "1" which is S 39_10' E., 4,328.31 meters from BLLM No. 39, Baler Cadastre,
Municipality of Baler, Province of Quezon; thence S 0_10' E., 1,844.15 meters to point 2; thence S 89_ 50'
W., 1,786.64 meters to point 3; thence N 0_10' W., 1,844.14 meters to point 4; then S 89_50' W., 893.21
meters to point 5 thence N 0_10' W., 2,766.36 meters to point 6; thence N 89_50' E., 1,786.40 meters to point
7; thence S 0_10' E., 922.11 meters to point 8; thence N 89_50' E., 1,786.42 meters to point 9; thence S 0_10'
E., 1,844.22 meters to point 10; thence S 89_50' W., 893.2 meters to point 1 which is the beginning,
containing an area of One Thousand One Fifty Three & 1519/10,000 (1,153.1519) hectares, more or less, as
indicated in the attached Plan of the Boundary Survey.
This Decree takes effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
